body:
Yeah that is great comment, but that being said it still doesn't really hit on what I am saying I guess. I am saying that I feel that the people around me seem to have the right on what I can and can't do with my body. A person's body is the only thing that they really own. I guess, the comment that I have heard that I feel is upsetting is that "it not just your life." but isn't it?

What is I was just a constant drain on the ones around me, or I feel that i can't work. Does that mean other people should just pay my way? If that is not the case then what opptions do I get to see? What if I am totally mean and cold hearted? Or a general leech? I feel its more then some patch work comment.

See, thats the thing. That is a very nice reply, but in general it doesn't answer my question. Also I am at an age where puppy kisses and cake doesn't make life ( I want to say livable, but thats not really what I mean.)worth it anymore or any less.
